gloss: account of one's experience; personal story

definitions.gloss: account of one's experience; personal story; firsthand account
definitions.explanation: A story or account based on something the speaker has personally experienced. Often used when someone shares their real-life experiences to inform, advise, or entertain others.

examples.japanese: {経験談|けいけんだん}を{聞|き}かせてください。
{先輩|せんぱい}の{経験談|けいけんだん}はとても{参考|さんこう}になった。
examples.english: My senior's firsthand account was very helpful.

examples.japanese: ネットには{留学|りゅうがく}の{経験談|けいけんだん}がたくさん{載|の}っている。
examples.english: There are many personal accounts of studying abroad posted online.

notes:
Composed of {経験|けいけん} (experience) + {談|だん} (talk, story). The suffix {談|だん} appears in many compound words for types of stories or accounts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経験談|けいけんだん}を{語|かた}る: to tell about one's experience
- {経験談|けいけんだん}を{聞|き}く: to hear someone's experience
- {経験談|けいけんだん}を{共有|きょうゆう}する: to share one's experience
- {貴重|きちょう}な{経験談|けいけんだん}: a valuable personal account

RELATED WORDS WITH 〜{談|だん}:
- {体験談|たいけんだん}: personal experience story (very similar, emphasizes firsthand physical involvement)
- {武勇伝|ぶゆうでん}: tale of heroic exploits
- {失敗談|しっぱいだん}: story of failure
- {成功談|せいこうだん}: success story
